note: Fish Creek (loops A-D) and Lynwood campgrounds sit together in forest on the north shore of Kenosee Lake, beside the Kenosee Lake village, 22 km north of Carlyle off Hwy 9. A separate rustic equestrian camp (Horseshoe Campground) is elsewhere in the park. --Claude
summary: Keep. SKPP: 367 campsites in Fish Creek A-D + Lynwood (253 nightly electric, 28 full service, 11 non-electric, 75 seasonal electric), 15/30/50 A, max 58 ft; one contiguous complex (no split); season May 14 - Sep 30 with Lynwood winter camping Nov 1 - Mar 14. Not waterfront confirmed (every site 'Near Water - no'; lake 50-80 m through forest). Pin inside Fish Creek C (fine).
flags: WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. All 367 SKPP site rows say 'Near Water - no'. On Esri z16 the westmost Fish Creek A sites (A32 49.82735,-102.3309) and Lynwood's southmost (L16 49.82682,-102.3275) are about 60-80 m from Kenosee Lake through continuous forest; no site has open ground to the water. Stored evidence ('set back ~100-200m ... behind forest') slightly overstates the distance but the call stands.
